correctness.rationale: The reverse-arrow process is an exact dual; the j-to-(j-1) probability \(j(j+z-1)/n^2\) follows from uniform independently chosen updater and sample. The pure-death chain has independent geometric holding times, giving the product PGF and partial-fraction survival law. The leading coefficient telescopes and the fixed-z exponential limit follows by uniform expected-tail truncation and a finite exponential moment. Direct exact rational forward-vs-dual verification passes 770 finite cases; no finite sampling is treated as a proof.

value.rationale: For source-anchored opinion spread the gap between mean stabilization and high-confidence tail is mathematically substantive. The exact finite law quantifies any quantile, provides a sharp first-eigenmode survival prefactor, identifies non-concentration in the \(n^2\) scaling limit, and handles every source count z without large simulation. It is a natural complete-graph baseline for robust dissemination rather than an arbitrary finite invariant; special-case exact means and textbook coalescent duality are not asserted to be new.
